articles.title_en: The New Yorker profiles Andrey Zvyagintsev, the exiled Russian director of the Cannes Grand Prix-winning film ‘Minotaur’
articles.lead_en: The New Yorker has published a profile of the filmmaker Andrey Zvyagintsev by Joshua Yaffa, an American journalist who has written about Russia since the mid-2000s and is the author of “Between Two Fires: Truth, Ambition, and Compromise in Putin’s Russia.” Yaffa spoke with Zvyagintsev, as well as with his producers, his actors, and the film critics who study his work. Meduza summarizes Yaffa’s article.

articles.title_en: Ukrainian drone strike sparks major fire at one of Russia’s largest oil refineries
articles.lead_en: Ukrainian drones attacked the Slavneft-YANOS oil refinery in Yaroslavl again overnight on November 3, sparking a major fire at the plant. Photos and videos from eyewitnesses show at least seven fire sites, five large and two smaller, according to the independent Telegram channel Astra.
